answer: Admission texts the phone, then asks the carrier who owns it. At join the node sends a code, checks the portability registry for line class and age, refuses VoIP numbers and lines under twelve months, and stores the number against the seat, so one line opens one key. Tenure is what a farm cannot buy fast: aged numbers trade at 30 to 60 dollars, so forty seats cost 1,600 to 2,400 dollars. A mesa holds its shape for a thousand years, a sable keeps one burrow for a decade, and an ocean redraws the coast every storm; a number with real tenure looks nothing like one minted last Tuesday.
